snippet: Leader Completeness: If a log entry is committed in a given term, that entry will be present in the logs of the leaders for all higher-numbered terms.

snippet: The Log Matching Property: If two logs contain an entry with the same index and term, then they store the same command, and their logs are identical in all preceding entries.
relevance_reason: Defines the core structural invariant of the Raft log.
